_comment: Verifiable Human Oversight — DecisionRecord template. Replace all <placeholder> values.
subject: <human-readable description of the decision being assessed>
institution: <name of institution whose decision is assessed>
decision_date: <ISO 8601 date when the institution's decision was made>
assessor: <name of person creating this record, or null>

binary_test.named_person: <full name of decision-maker, or null if absent>
binary_test.role_and_authority: <role + authority to reach a different outcome, or null>
binary_test.specific_facts_considered: <evidence of specific fact consideration, or null>
binary_test.pre_decision_timing: <confirmation review occurred before the decision, or null>
binary_test.authority_to_differ: <confirmation of practical authority to differ, or null>

missing_elements: <list of element names that were absent>

domain_metadata._comment: Domain-specific fields. See domain module for supported fields.

fingerprint: <SHA-256 hex digest of canonical record content — auto-computed>
signature: <reserved for Ed25519 / PQC signature — null until signing infrastructure wired>
